slides.text: what you taught me without ever saying a word
how to share a warm bottle of soda from the cooler by leaving [[exactly two sips]] at the bottom.
staying on the cold basement stairs in silence when the kitchen upstairs got too loud.
that a broken yellow vase is just a mistake if we sweep the pieces under the rug before dark.
holding the heavy flashlight steady so i could climb the fence first, even when you wanted to go.
how to pretend to be fast asleep in the backseat at midnight so the grown-ups would carry us both inside.
that we could survive any long dinner by [[catching each other's eye]] across the crowded table.
save this for the cousin who still remembers the jokes we made up under the garden table.

caption:
we spent our summers dusty, sunburnt, and looking for trouble.
now we only see each other at the big family dinners once a year.
but when we sit next to each other, the years disappear.
save this for the cousin you grew up with.
alt: A slide-by-slide list of silent lessons learned with a childhood cousin, illustrated with a small green donkey.
